slide_1.title: NovaRetail Performance Review
slide_1.executive_summary: Revenue growth is positive, driven by strong performance in APAC. Customer satisfaction is stable overall, but regional disparities persist. Latin America shows significant operational challenges including stockouts and fraud.

slide_2.headline: Regional Performance Highlights
insights: APAC leads with 8.2% QoQ revenue growth.
Latin America experienced a decline of -6.7% QoQ.
Regional performance varies significantly, requiring targeted strategies.

slide_3.headline: Customer Experience Insights
insights: Overall NPS is 49.75, indicating steady customer loyalty.
APAC region boasts the highest NPS at 62.
Latin America's NPS is notably low at 29, aligning with other regional challenges.

slide_4.headline: Operational Risk Assessment
insights: Latin America faces the highest stockout rate at 12.5%.
Latin America also reports the highest number of fraud incidents (30).
APAC operates at high capacity (92.0%), nearing saturation.

slide_5.headline: Strategic Recommendations
actions: Address Latin America's operational issues: reduce stockouts and combat fraud.
Investigate and mitigate the low NPS in Latin America.
Monitor APAC's high capacity utilization to prevent future stockouts.
slide_5.forward_looking_statement: Focusing on these key areas will drive sustained growth and improve overall business health.
